note: Lab safety feedback; includes a conflicting severity pair.

corrections.author: biomed.eng@example.com
corrections.subject: wrong software version
corrections.body: The affected analyzer ran control-software 7.1.2, not 7.2.0. Analyzers on 7.2.0 halt aspiration correctly.

corrections.author: qa_reviewer
corrections.subject: duration + blank actions
corrections.body: The halt was three hours (08:20 to 11:20), and Corrective Actions is blank.

corrections.author: lab.director@example.com
corrections.subject: severity too low
corrections.body: A reagent spill contaminating patient samples is Major, not Minor.

corrections.author: qa_reviewer
corrections.subject: severity assessment
corrections.body: Contained with no confirmed patient impact beyond one tray, so Moderate per the matrix.

corrections.author: qa_reviewer
corrections.subject: wrong figure
corrections.body: The Timeline figure reference is wrong; it should be the spill containment zone.
